fields.statement: Unclaimed changes: where does the cutoff (commits after which rhiza check warns on a missing Change: trailer) live? It must be committed so CI sees it; repo.json is currently a strict canonical format-1 file with format/id/remotes. / Unclaimed changes: which commits after the cutoff count as claimed? (Only commits that change a file outside .rhiza/ are considered, as the evidence-actor rule already does.) / Unclaimed changes: should this repo turn the rule on as part of this change set, with the cutoff set to the main commit it lands on?
